newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown starts retailer stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown starts retailer stocks.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said analyst Pat McCormack initiated a group of retailer stocks on Friday, most as market performers.
-- two retailers, Federated Department Stores Inc and Dayton Hudson Corp were started as strong buy.

-- the following were initiated as market perform: Wal-Mart Stores Inc; Sears, Roebuck and Co; K Mart Corp; J.C. Penney Co Inc; Nordstrom Inc; Kohl's Corp; Dillard Department Stores Inc; May Department Stores Co.

-- Federated rose 7/8 to 34-1/2, Dayton Hudson jumped 1-3/4 to 46-3/8, Wal-Mart was unchanged at 28-1/4, Sears added 1/4 to 48-1/2, K Mart edged off 1/8 to 13-1/2, Penney added 5/8 to 48-3/4, Nordstrom rose 1/8 to 41-5/8, Kohl's jumped one to 50-1/4, Dillard's was unchanged at 31-3/8, and May was up 1/2 to 46-3/8.
